basic_details.job_title: Sivasagar District Mouzadar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Sivasagar District has announced 1 vacancy for theMouzadar post. Candidates can apply through an offline application submitted by hand to the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Sivasagar (Nazir Section), Assam on or before 30 October 2026. Applicants must have passed HSLC or equivalent with land surveying knowledge. The pay is provided as per rules under advertisement number CN/TN/En/2023-TN-SIV. The selection process involves application screening followed by an interview.

qualification.details: Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam and must have passed the HSLC or equivalent examination. A recognized certificate or knowledge in land surveying from a recognized institute is required. The applicant must be able to write and speak Assamese fluently. The candidate must be a sound financial guarantor as per rules, capable of depositing security money as required for the Mouzadar post, and must be able to perform outdoor duties in local areas under the Nazira sub-division of Sivasagar district. The applicant must not have been convicted of any criminal offense involving moral turpitude. | FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted by hand at the designated office address. The submission details are as follows: Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Sivasagar (Nazir Section), District - Sivasagar, Assam Candidates must submit their applications to the Nazir Section office room in the Deputy Commissioner's Office, Sivasagar.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam and must have passed the HSLC or equivalent examination. A recognized certificate or knowledge in land surveying from a recognized institute is required. The applicant must be able to write and speak Assamese fluently. The candidate must be a sound financial guarantor as per rules, capable of depositing security money as required for the Mouzadar post, and must be able to perform outdoor duties in local areas under the Nazira sub-division of Sivasagar district.
